title: Others coming and going can price a staker out of withdrawing
rootCause: LayerEdgeStaking.calculateUnclaimedInterest walks a staker's whole tier history on every action, and the history grows without bound each time another account crosses a tier boundary, so a staker's own calls eventually cost more gas than a block holds.

poc.observable: test_a_stakers_withdrawal_fits_in_a_block fails with "gas for the withdrawal: 34332666 >= 30000000"
